checks.scope: rank-one coefficient/shear identities and constants only

main_results.name: QFORM-SHAREDHUB-2x2-TENSOR-L1-v1
main_results.statement: For independent scalar hub H and two 2D banks Y,Z with density caps M_Y,M_Z, phase 2H(alpha Y1+beta Z1)+2sigma Y2Z2 plus arbitrary within-bank phases satisfies |phi(t)|<=pi^(3/2)sqrt(M_YM_Z)|alpha beta sigma|^(-1/2)|t|^(-3/2), hence ||p||inf<=3(M_YM_Z)^(1/3)T^(-1/6), T=(alpha beta sigma)^2.

main_results.name: QFORM-ZEROPIVOT-RANKONE-CROSS-TENSOR-L1-v1
main_results.statement: For a literal zero-pivot shared hub and rank-one residual crossing N, T=||c||^2||r||^2||P_cNP_r||_F^2>0 implies ||p_Q||inf<=3*2^(2/3)T^(-1/6)=4.7622031559 T^(-1/6) and int|phi|<=6pi*2^(2/3)T^(-1/6), with continuous C0 density.

main_results.name: partner_r38_application
main_results.statement: Partner random cut gives T>=Delta_i/16 at A_ii=0. If that cut has rank N=1, ||p_Q||inf<=3*2^(4/3)Delta_i^(-1/6)=7.55952629937 Delta_i^(-1/6), int|phi|<=6pi*2^(4/3)Delta_i^(-1/6)=47.4979045734 Delta_i^(-1/6).

main_results.name: Dprime_D5_obstruction_on_exact_endpoint
main_results.statement: For rank-one N the natural physical hub-plus-bank cross matrices have rank<=2, so E3=E5=0 and D'/D5 cannot pay this endpoint; the shared-hub tensor theorem supplies the missing half power.

main_results.name: Fisher_review
main_results.statement: Independent recheck of weak IBP, cutoff, inverse-distance inequality and centered-primitive factor is PASS on the source's extra Fisher/H1 scope; no rough-input closure claimed.
